description: [holidaycn] List every official holiday day off and every make-up workday (调休上班) in mainland China for one year, e.g. to tell whether a date is a working day or plan around 春节/国庆. Returns entries of name (Chinese holiday name), date (YYYY-MM-DD) and isOffDay (true = day off, false = make-up workday). Ordinary weekends are not listed; a date that is absent follows the normal Mon-Fri rule. Data usually appears in November for the next year.
name: holidaycn_year
title: China public holidays: year
